item.title: Just keep on "Save for later"
item.author: andreffs18@gmail.com (André Silva)
item.description:
Since this #remotelife began, sadly not for the best reasons, I’ve been able to finally clean my backlog of, guess what, TV Shows, Games, Podcasts, Books… Well, everything that a person is suppose to do!

Very happy was I until I remembered that, maybe I should start looking into the “To Read” bookmarks, “Saved” on Reddit and, the holy grail, “Read Later” of Feedly.

While the “Saved” section on Reddit was mostly threads from /r/cscarrearquestions (and some memes from /r/wsb 😂) the other two places were actual interesting articles that I have planned on reading.
